initial.prompt:
Create ONE finished landscape 16:9 game UI concept screenshot for a 2D hand-painted western tavern management game named 致未归的客人. It is a NEW LOCATION: a frontier coastal port supply shop called 港口货栈. This is the visual mockup for a Godot game with a 1600x900 logical viewport. Use attached references for continuity, especially reference 1 for the existing brown wooden/brass UI and reference 3 for parchment ink treatment, and reference 2 for the distinct matte hand-painted bottles. Do not copy the indoor tavern scene. Design a new coherent harbor environment and merchant, not a collage.

Art direction: richly illustrated 2D western frontier harbor, late 19th century, softly painted matte gouache with thin warm brown drawing lines, wood texture and restrained brass trims, sea in subdued turquoise and slate blue. Warm afternoon diffuse light, minimal reflections, readable shapes and believable spatial staging. No photorealism, no glossy 3D plastic, no blazing golden rim light, no sci-fi, no modern shopping dashboard. Maritime and western motifs in balance, rope, wooden cargo crates, barrel, canvas awning, a tied-up wooden sailing cargo ship clearly visible in the left and upper background, mast and furled ivory sails, quiet water and distant low frontier port buildings. The ship must be recognizable and not blocked by UI.

Composition:
- Full-bleed harbor scene. Top slim dark wooden bar about 9% screen height with delicate thin brass outline, left return arrow and Chinese text 回酒馆, centered small carved wood title 港口货栈, right simple coin icon and 金币 300. No sidebar on this location; the return action is enough.
- LEFT roughly 37% of screen: scene and friendly merchant NPC. A young adult white-haired woman, around twenty years old, silver-white medium-length hair in a loose side braid, thoughtful friendly eyes, proportioned and illustrated like a western game character, NOT exaggerated chibi and NOT a glossy modern anime avatar. Practical cream linen shirt with rolled sleeves, muted teal neckerchief, brown leather vest, simple work apron, dark modest trousers, worn leather belt and pouch. A small bronze compass brooch and a folded cargo list make her a port merchant. She stands naturally BEHIND the dock's wooden shop counter, torso visible above it and correct feet/counter relationship. One hand lightly rests on the counter while the other holds a paper receipt. She faces the player. No weapons. No exaggerated pose, cleavage, or costume frills. Her silver hair and teal scarf provide a memorable silhouette. Background sailing ship remains visible over her shoulder.
- Bottom left a compact irregular pale parchment dialogue note on the counter, tasteful charcoal ink, text exactly: 船刚靠岸，今天的货都在这儿了。 No NPC lore or additional text. Never a floating system tutorial box.
- RIGHT roughly 61%: a large single worn kraft parchment goods ledger placed within a low-profile dark wooden backing. It has hand-inked ornament corners and modest cargo stamps, unified with the existing codex's paper aesthetic. It begins beneath top bar and fills the right lower three-quarters of screen. The main panel should not cover the entire screen or hide the ship/NPC. Top heading 今日货品 with a tiny ship stamp, then five tabs written directly in ink ON PAPER: 原酒  配料  装饰品  器材  杯型. 原酒 is current with an understated brown ink underline, no big colored tab buttons.
- Under categories, 6 item cards in a carefully aligned THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW grid. Cards are ink outlines drawn directly on the same parchment, no glossy boxes or separate ivory tiles. Each card has a highly distinguishable softly painted bottle centered, name and cost in neat Chinese below. No complex extra badges. Six items:
  1 伦敦干金酒, 60 金币: flat rectangular blue bottle, navy screw cap, cream label with juniper sprig, GIN.
  2 白朗姆酒, 50 金币: clear long-neck bottle, white cap, white cream broad label with red small round emblem and RUM.
  3 伏特加, 55 金币: squat wide clear rounded medicine-style bottle, short neck, silver cap, blue-letter VODKA.
  4 龙舌兰酒, 70 金币: fat broad clear glass bottle, large round wooden cork, green neck band and agave label.
  5 绿查特酒, 90 金币: tall narrow green herbal bottle, dark black cap, cream vertical herb label.
  6 黑麦威士忌, 65 金币: broad flat short amber bottle with brown cork and wide muted green RYE label.
  First gin card is selected with a subtle darker ink frame, other cards visually identical. Text does not dominate the beautiful bottle images.
- Bottom of the SAME ledger below a thin hand-drawn ink separator is selected-item purchase summary, coherent and spacious, text: 伦敦干金酒  |  杜松子 · 草本, and next line 750 ml / 瓶    库存：0 瓶. At bottom a simple quantity control -  1  + on parchment, readable text 合计 60 金币, and a single dark brown leather/wood brass-edged button 购买. A tiny note 首次购入可点亮材料 near summary, no systems jargon or API talk.
- Small hand-inked pagination below grid 页 1 / 2 with subtle left and right arrows, not dominating UI.
Keep all Chinese text large and legible. Strong typography hierarchy, generous padding and breathing room. The interface looks part of this harbor shop's tangible goods ledger. Deliver ONE cohesive usable concept screenshot only, no outer presentation border, no moodboard, no explanatory overlays.

daylight_edit.prompt: Edit this single existing harbor shop UI concept screenshot. Preserve ALL composition, framing, characters, white-haired merchant, dock, ship, parchment panel, bottle shapes, item grid, every Chinese text, labels, prices, buttons and ink ornaments EXACTLY as they are. Make only one targeted adjustment: the brass lantern in the lower-left foreground is switched OFF for daytime. Remove its visible flame and bright orange/yellow glow inside its glass and any warm glow it casts on nearby small bottles and wood. Make the lantern glass clear neutral softly shaded, naturally lit by ambient daylight. Keep the beautiful daytime outdoor illumination and warm natural wood tones. Do not add, remove or move the lantern. Do not change anything else. Keep the image opaque and full-bleed 16:9.

shelf_edit.prompt:
Edit the attached 16:9 harbor shop concept screenshot, making a NEW v0.2 with PHYSICAL WOODEN MERCHANDISE SHELVES. Preserve the entire LEFT half scene and merchant character exactly: the young adult white-haired female port shopkeeper in her cream shirt, brown leather vest, teal neck scarf, side braid, compass brooch, pose holding a receipt behind the counter, the dock, sailing cargo ship, harbor town, and the small dialogue note. Preserve the top header bar, title 港口货栈, return text 回酒馆, and 金币 300. The small brass lantern at lower-left should remain OFF in daytime, with neutral clear glass and no flame or glow.

Completely transform the large RIGHT goods ledger into a REAL FRONT-FACING WOODEN SHOP SHELF display, integrated into the harbor stall. The objects are tangible goods standing on shelf planks. This is the user's specific requested design change; the entire product display must read as a physical stocked wooden shelf rather than a sheet of cards.

Shelf construction and UI:
- Right area approximately x=44% to 99% of image width beneath top header. Construct a tall timber cargo shop shelf with two wide horizontal wooden planks, slightly worn matte dark walnut, simple iron corner brackets, restrained brass nails, visible wood grain, gentle watercolor ink contours. Open or softly shaded wood backboards, readable bottle silhouettes. Keep one single physical shelf cabinet rather than six framed card compartments. NO big parchment backing sheet behind products. NO rectangular product card outlines or grids drawn around the bottles.
- At the shelf's top a modest wood lintel with Chinese text 今日货品, a small ink ship icon, and five thin dangling wooden category plaques with text 原酒, 配料, 装饰品, 器材, 杯型. Selected 原酒 has only a subtle engraved underline. Category tabs look attached to the shelf, no bright modern buttons.
- First plank displays THREE standing actual bottles, each generously spaced. Bottle bases rest precisely ON the wood surface; no hovering:
  left: blue flat squared GIN bottle with navy cap, cream juniper label, name 伦敦干金酒, price 60 金币.
  middle: long clear white-rum bottle with white cap, cream label and red emblem RUM, name 白朗姆酒, price 50 金币.
  right: squat broad rounded clear VODKA bottle short neck silver cap blue word VODKA, name 伏特加, price 55 金币.
- Second plank displays THREE standing bottles:
  left: broad squat rounded tequila clear bottle with large round wooden cork and green agave label, name 龙舌兰酒, price 70 金币.
  middle: slender green herbal bottle with black cap and cream herb label, name 绿查特酒, price 90 金币.
  right: flat squat broad amber whiskey bottle with cork and muted green RYE label, name 黑麦威士忌, price 65 金币.
- Every product name and price is printed on its own small kraft-paper inventory hang tag tied or pinned to the FRONT EDGE of the plank directly below the bottle. Tags have tasteful irregular paper edges, fine charcoal handwriting and small coin icon. They are price labels, NOT full product cards. The blue gin's paper price tag may have a thin stronger ink outline indicating selected, without glow. Bottle sizes may differ naturally while names remain aligned and large enough to read.
- Small shelf footer hand-inked 页 1 / 2 with left and right arrows. The product shelving is the visually dominant right-side element.
- At the very BOTTOM of the right shelf, retain a compact horizontal parchment PURCHASE SLIP resting on a wooden checkout lip or pull-out drawer. This is the only larger paper panel on the right, roughly last 16% of screen height. Show selected gin thumbnail and text 伦敦干金酒 | 杜松子 · 草本, below 750 ml / 瓶    库存：0 瓶. Simple quantity control - 1 +, 合计 60 金币, a modest dark wooden/brass button 购买. Tiny note 首次购入可点亮材料. Fit cleanly without obstructing products.
- Retain left-side dialogue text exactly 船刚靠岸，今天的货都在这儿了。

Keep the existing coherent western 2D hand-painted illustration style, muted teal sea, warm natural afternoon daylight, wood, leather and aged parchment. Matte bottles from the original screenshot with gentle diffuse reflections, no excessive gloss or bright gold outlines. Keep merchant unchanged, no new people, no modern shopping dashboard, no floating item boxes. All Chinese labels correct and clear. Output ONE polished full-bleed 16:9 game UI screenshot.

pricing: Layout examples only; catalog values not changed
